decision.settlement_timezone_authority: market_registry.settlement_timezone with exact probability/truth/TAF/WS match; mismatch FAIL_CLOSED
decision.p0_readiness: materialize and preselect on any activated 2+ model exact mask; do not wait for TAF or all three models
decision.taf_role: P0-M is one atomic TAF checkpoint: calibrated TX first confirms or boundedly revises P0, then cloud/precipitation/wind physically confirm that revision direction and discount its strength when conflicting; every OOS sample binds station/season/lead/run-cycle/settlement scope and the same-decision NWP combination artifact; holdout TAF-vs-NWP residual correlation discounts duplicate evidence; never a second center, separate stage, hard exclusion, or P0 blocker
decision.final_ssot: P1; malformed, stale, or missing P1 evidence never falls back to executable P0
decision.cash_clip_authority: explicit versioned BasketCashPhasePolicyArtifact after station target/reserve resolution

placement.layer: L4 station policy compiler before AdaptiveBasketEvaluator
hard_boundaries: station policy cannot modify p_s(B), c_s*, or sign(D_s)
station reserve price cannot exceed the B14 mathematical ceiling
station cadence cannot bypass B13, budget, risk, or known-order-state gates
cash phase is execution sizing state, not P0/P0-M/P1 evidence stage and cannot modify support, center, direction, or target inventory
diagnostic extrema only diagnose disagreement; candidate boundary only caps search; final support is sparse and probability/value qualified

families.output: per-bucket target cost and share weights within the current support set
families.constraint: station allocation may change concentration but cannot reverse current-stage posterior direction
hazard opens scheduling only after all eligibility gates pass

hierarchical_model.effective_sample_size: event-cluster, season, stage, and serial-correlation adjusted
hierarchical_model.hyperparameter_rule: pre-registered and promoted only through strict temporal, leave-station-out, and cross-season OOS

global_cash_phase_policy.placement: after target inventory and reserve-price resolution, before order cash/share sizing
global_cash_phase_policy.phase_clock: station-local event date and IANA timezone
global_cash_phase_policy.private_switch_time_rule: the 10.800-minute gap between last old and first new observation is an unidentified interval, not an exact activation timestamp

fallback.insufficient_station_data: use promoted global or regional fallback only when exact fallback mask is activated

comparisons: same-station temporal holdout versus global prior
leave-one-station-out versus random and market baselines
metric_families: reserve-price interval likelihood and execution cost
cadence waiting-time calibration and over-trading rate
scenario PnL, concentration, outside-basket loss, and capital usage

evidence.interpretation: pooled behavior is a useful prior but station heterogeneity rules out one direct global execution formula

awc_global_primary_contract.use: 45站实时 truth/P1/纯YES篮子硬事实排除、offline OOS/calibration and production_no_live P0 artifact
